messages:
maya: Hi all — Maya here, first day on infra. Using Windows + WSL2 (Ubuntu). Trying to get dev env: asdf for node/python, direnv, and my dotfiles. Problems: asdf node sometimes not on PATH in VS Code terminal; git pushes go through Windows credential manager instead of SSH; and GPG signing via my YubiKey is awkward. Any quick fixes?

oliver: welcome! For VS Code + WSL install Remote - WSL and reopen folder in WSL. Make sure asdf init is sourced in a file that runs for non-login shells (put into ~/.profile and ~/.bashrc). Also check VS Code setting `terminal.integrated.shellArgs.linux` and add `-l` to force a login shell.

maya: I put asdf init in .bashrc but still see 'node: command not found' unless I open a new full shell. Is forcing login the usual approach?

tara: we use a repo-level .envrc + direnv; that loads envs on folder open. Also we set `terminal.integrated.shellArgs.linux: ['-l']` in workspace settings. Direnv avoids manual reloads.

kevin: For the Git issue, change remote to SSH: `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:org/repo.git` and run `eval $(ssh-agent) && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` in WSL. Git for Windows' credential manager can cause HTTPS pushes; removing credential.helper in WSL helps: `git config --global --unset credential.helper`.

maya: changed to SSH and added key, pushes work now. But commit signing still prompts because my YubiKey is on Windows. How do folks sign from WSL?

tara: hardware tokens are messy in WSL. Two options: 1) temporarily disable commit signing and upload your SSH key to GitHub, or 2) proxy GPG: we have a small wrapper that calls Windows gpg via powershell and sets `git config --global gpg.program ~/.local/bin/gpg-wsl-wrapper`. DM me if you want the script.

onboard-bot: Reminder: complete "add SSH key / enable commit signing" step on onboarding tracker: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/keys

maya: Installed stow for dotfiles (needed apt install stow). Dotfiles install succeeded. If someone could add me to #infra that'd be great.

onboard-bot: Maya added to #infra.

maya: thanks everyone, saved me a lot of time — will DM tara for the gpg wrapper and kevin for org key invite. :)
